meta.name: gget
meta.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取基因、序列与蛋白结构等生物数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要快速查询基因、序列和结构等生物数据
copy.tagline_en: Query gene, sequence, and structure data from 20+ bio databases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need quick lookups of gene, sequence, and protein structure data in bio research.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 gget 查询 20 多个生物数据库，例如查基因信息、做序列比对、获取蛋白质结构等，并把结果以表格或文件形式返回。
howto.when: 当任务属于快速的生物信息检索时触发：例如查基因信息、做 BLAST/BLAT 比对、下载病毒序列等；不适合批量或高级分析。

say.text: 把这段蛋白序列拿去 BLAST：MKWMFKEDHSLEHR。
say.note: 会运行 gget blast，返回相似序列列表。

say.text: 列出人类参考基因组可下载的文件。
say.note: 会运行 gget ref，返回 Ensembl 下载链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use gget to query 20+ bio databases, e.g. gene lookups, sequence alignment, protein structures, returning results as tables or files.
howto.when_en: Triggered for quick bioinformatics lookups, e.g. gene info, BLAST/BLAT alignment, or viral sequence downloads; not intended for batch or advanced analysis.

Runs gget blast and returns similar sequences.
